references.note: Two real DSMs are represented by one designed impulse in the search template. Jupiter arrival is July 5 UTC (July 4 in US mission reporting).
Planet encounters only; this list is not the complete maneuver history.
The Venus-return DSM is explicit. Search ranges are not exact mission reconstruction constraints.
Actual MESSENGER used several DSMs. The planet-only route is a screening template; a DSM variant is also supplied.

conventions.timing: Broad analyst-selected search bounds informed by flown leg durations.
conventions.branches: Prograde Lambert M/low-path choices; higher M can be added in JSON.
conventions.status: Sequence templates, not a precomputed feasibility catalog.
